title.narrative: UK Collaborative on Development Sciences Support Grant

description.narrative: This activity UK Collaborative on Development Sciences Support Grant is a component of UK Collaborative on Development Sciences (UKCDS) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £542,322. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Communications policy and administrative management.
